groups.note: Global Business Electives (Courses from the specified elective list, of which at least 6 credits from Area A, and at least 1 course from Area B and Area C, respectively. With approval of the program office, students may replace the requirement of completing one Additional Major/Extended Major/Minor (see 'Others' below) by taking additional 9 credits at 3000-level or above from this elective list, with at least 1 course from Area A out of the additional 9 credits.) Areas: A: Global Business; B: Global and Societal Perspective; C: Business Strategy and Innovation.
